concepts.definition: the production of new plants from seeds or vegetative plant parts
a prepared area of soil or growing medium in which seeds are sown for germination and early growth
a managed place where young plants are raised and cared for before sale or transplanting
the transfer of a seedling or young plant from one growing location to another
the selective removal of plant parts to control shape, health, growth, or productivity
covering the soil surface with material to conserve moisture, suppress weeds, and protect the soil
decomposed organic material used to improve soil structure and supply nutrients
the controlled application of water to crops or growing media to meet plant water needs
the planned prevention, monitoring, and control of organisms that damage crops
the timely collection or removal of mature crop produce from the field or growing system
